scenes.text: Why does AI sometimes make things up, with total confidence? [1] And why does the same question get a different answer each time? [2] In this episode, temperature and hallucinations.

Remember, an L L M picks the next word from a list of likely options. [1] Temperature controls how adventurous that pick is. [2] Low temperature, it plays safe. [3] High temperature, it takes risks. [4] Same model, different personality.

data.definition: A setting that controls how random or creative the AI's word choices are.

scenes.text: Let's turn the dial. The prompt: describe the moon in one line. [1] At zero, you get a plain, factual answer. The same every time. [2] Around point seven, it gets more vivid. [3] At one, it's wild and poetic. Sometimes, too wild.

data.heading: Turn the dial
data.prompt: Describe the Moon in one line.
settings: The Moon is Earth's only natural satellite.
The Moon is a silver lantern hanging over a quiet sea.
The Moon: a cosmic cheese-wheel humming lullabies to sleepy comets.

scenes.text: When should you use which? [1] Here's a cheat sheet. [2] Maths and facts? Low temperature. [3] Writing code? Low. [4] Brainstorming. Turn it up. [5] Poems and stories. High.
Now, hallucinations. [1] A hallucination is when the AI confidently says something false. [2] Made up facts. [3] Made up quotes. [4] Even citations to research papers that don't exist.

data.definition: When the AI confidently makes up something that isn't true.

scenes.text: Why does it happen? [1] The model is trained to sound fluent, not to check facts. [2] If it doesn't know, it still predicts something that sounds right. [3] And a higher temperature adds more randomness, and more risk.

How to protect yourself. [1] Ask for sources, and actually check them. [2] Give it the facts yourself, right in the prompt. That's the idea behind RAG, coming soon. [3] And tell it, if you're not sure, say I don't know.

data.heading: How to reduce it
items: Make it OK to be unsure

scenes.text: Quick quiz! You're writing code for a banking app. Which temperature? [1] Pause and think. <pause 3.2> [2] Low! You want precise, repeatable answers. Comment low if you got it!

scenes.text: Recap. [1] Temperature is the creativity dial. [2] Low is precise. [3] High is creative. [4] Hallucinations are confident mistakes, so always verify. [5] Next episode, embeddings. How AI understands meaning, using maths. Follow AI Maastaaru!
